bullets.title: A Pickpocket’s Tale: The spectacular thefts of Apollo Robbins
bullets.creator: Adam Green
bullets.note:
([@Adam\_\_\_Green](https://twitter.com/adam___green)) (_The New Yorker_). This was sent to me by [Jeffrey Zurofsky](https://www.instagram.com/jeffreyzurofsky/?hl=en) (“JZ” from [_The 4-Hour Chef_](https://www.amazon.com/4-Hour-Chef-Cooking-Learning-Anything/dp/1328519163/)). Here’s one paragraph to give you a taste:  
​  
​_When Robbins hits his stride, it starts to seem as if the only possible explanation is an ability to start and stop time. At the Rio, a man’s cell phone disappeared from his jacket and was replaced by a piece of fried chicken; the cigarettes from a pack in one man’s breast pocket materialized loose in the side pocket of another; a woman’s engagement ring vanished and reappeared attached to a key ring in her husband’s pants; a man’s driver’s license disappeared from his wallet and turned up inside a sealed bag of M&M’s in his wife’s purse._

bullets.note: ([Tom Lord-Alge](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tom_Lord-Alge) Mix) ([Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/3Q4cYIHjHb13dJoUJGP339), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ltj4d9DVxG8&list=OLAK5uy_mA_3eYqZQl8XbQbusLOJVMJJqMVczB82o), [Apple Music](https://music.apple.com/us/album/waffle-tom-lord-alige-mix/311280451?i=311280515)) by [Sevendust](https://sevendust.com/) ([@Sevendust](https://twitter.com/sevendust?lang=en)). Sevendust is one of my favorite bands, especially for exercise, and they are one of the best live bands I’ve ever seen. I only experienced the latter for the first time in fall of 2021 with [Dave Elitch](https://www.instagram.com/p/CZvGirPsvAA/).

bullets.title: Sheng Wang: Sweet and Juicy
bullets.note: I saw [Sheng Wang](https://www.shengwangtime.com/) ([@shengwangtime](https://mobile.twitter.com/shengwangtime)) open for [Ali Wong](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxxLmgleW1s) ([@aliwong](https://www.instagram.com/aliwong/)) in NYC a few years ago, and I laughed my ass off. He’s dry [like Mitch Hedberg](https://youtu.be/vrIw2i4WtA4) and takes on the tough task of clean comedy [like Jim Gaffigan](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OI743NOJ7mc) ([@JimGaffigan](https://twitter.com/jimgaffigan)). Here’s the description: “Sheng Wang delivers a laid-back set on juicing, mammograms, how snoring is an evolutionary mistake, and the existential angst of buying pants from Costco.” I’m omitting links to trailers on purpose, as I don’t think they do the special justice.

bullets.title: Runnin’ Down a Dream: How to Succeed and Thrive in a Career You Love
bullets.note:
This speech focuses on one topic: finding your dream path, where what’s easy for you is hard for others and what’s fun for you is work for others. Delivered by former basketball player and legendary venture capitalist [Bill Gurley](https://abovethecrowd.com/) ([@bgurley](https://twitter.com/bgurley?lang=en)), it contains good reminders for people in all stages of life.

The below quotes are all from one of his case studies, Bobby Knight…
